name: ohmyjev
description: Guardrails for coding agents, decided by TypeSafe's Jev: blocks destructive commands, catches prompt injection, pushes back on an unverified done and routes effort per turn. For Claude Code, pi and omp.

enabled.description: Off lets every call through. /omj off and /omj on change it for one session

apiKey.description: TypeSafe API key; empty uses TYPESAFE_API_KEY, then OPENROUTER_API_KEY

jevModel.description: Model id sent to the TypeSafe endpoint

maskSecrets.description: Replace keys, tokens, credentials in URLs, emails and your home folder with markers in everything sent to Jev

timeoutMs.description: Milliseconds to wait for Jev before failing open

bashGate.description: Deny irreversible or destructive shell and eval calls

writeGate.description: Deny writes outside the repo/allowPaths and writes holding credentials

exfilGate.description: Deny URL reads and MCP calls that send local data or credentials out

policies.description: Semicolon-separated user policies that every gate weighs

allowPaths.description: Semicolon-separated write paths outside the repo; ~ and TMPDIR expand

bashIrreversible.description: Deny when Jev rates a command irreversible at least this confidently (0-1)

bashDestructive.description: Deny when destructive intent is at least this probable (0-1)

writeSecret.description: Deny when write content holds a credential at least this probably (0-1)

writeSecretsKind.description: Deny when the destination is a secrets file at least this confidently (0-1)

exfil.description: Deny when Jev rates a call as sending local data out at least this probably (0-1)

requested.description: A gate's Jev deny passes when Jev rates your latest message as asking for exactly that call at least this probable (0-1). Policy and path denies always stand

injectionScreen.description: Warn the model when untrusted tool output contains instructions aimed at it

screenReads.description: Run the injection screen on files read from outside the repo/allowPaths

doneCheck.description: Push back once when the agent claims done without verifying

subagentCheck.description: Send a vague subagent brief back once, and check a subagent's done against its own tool record

proseCheck.description: Check the final reply against the writing rules in CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md, and ask for one rewrite when it breaks one (Claude Code)

stuckCheck.description: After repeated failed calls, ask Jev whether the agent is stuck on one approach and tell it to change course

injection.description: Flag tool output as prompt injection at this probability (0-1)

doneClaimed.description: Check only when Jev says completion was claimed at least this probably (0-1)

doneVerifiedMax.description: Push back when verification probability is below this value (0-1)

doneAsksUserMax.description: Skip pushback when the reply asks the user at or above this probability (0-1)

stuck.description: How sure Jev must be that the failures repeat one approach before the note (0-1)

autoApprove.description: Where the host would ask you, run a command or in-repo edit Jev is sure is safe instead

trimOutput.description: Cut a long shell output to the parts your request needs, Jev rating each part

skillPick.description: Claude Code only: leave the skill listing out of every prompt; Jev names the one skill a request needs

readNarrow.description: Claude Code only: a Read of a 400+ line file comes back as the fifth the request needs

approveConfidence.description: How sure Jev must be that a command only reads or is reversible (0-1)

approveRiskMax.description: Destructive, data-leaving or credential probability under which a call is approved (0-1)

trimOver.description: Characters of shell output before trimming is considered

trimKeep.description: How likely Jev must rate a part as needed for it to stay (0-1)

skillGate.description: Claude Code only: how strongly Jev must rate a request as needing a skill (0-1)

skillMin.description: Claude Code only: how sure Jev must be of which skill fits (0-1)

fastCompact.description: Compact in about a second: Jev keeps the messages that still matter, verbatim, instead of a model writing a summary

autoCompact.description: Compact after Jev sees a task change at a natural boundary

compactSwitched.description: Compact when task-switch probability reaches this value (0-1)

compactBoundary.description: Compact when boundary probability also reaches this value (0-1)

compactMinPercent.description: Only compact once context usage reaches this percentage (0-100)

routeEffort.description: Raise or lower reasoning effort per prompt from Jev's classification

routeSubagents.description: Pick the subagent model tier from the current request

routeMainModel.description: Also switch the main model per prompt

routeWithoutKey.description: Use a host small-model classifier when available and no Jev key is configured

fastModel.description: OMP model selector or role for the fast tier

balancedModel.description: OMP model selector or role for the balanced tier

deepModel.description: OMP model selector or role for the deep tier

routeUpgrade.description: Raise effort or model tier at this confidence or above (0-1)

routeDowngrade.description: Lower effort or model tier at this confidence or above (0-1)

routeRisky.description: At this probability a risky request routes deep with at least high effort (0-1)

askJev.description: Expose the ask_jev tool for quick judgments about repo files or text

findCode.description: Expose a find_code tool: Jev finds the files that carry out a described behaviour

browse.description: Expose a browse tool: jev-ultrafast does a task in your Chrome, Jev picking each step. Needs uv, Chrome remote debugging, and OPENROUTER_API_KEY to type into fields

logDecisions.description: Show display-only routing and lifecycle decision lines

statusLine.description: Pin Jev calls, denies and route in the OMP status area

scripts.test: bun test adapters && claude plugin test .
